name: amebartos
title: Realtek Ameba RTOS
description: Realtek Ameba family of Wi-Fi + Bluetooth IoT MCUs (RTL8710 / RTL8720 / RTL8721 / RTL8730 series). Backed by the official ameba-rtos SDK. Supports the AmebaGreen2 (RTL8721F dual-core KM4TZ + KM4NS), AmebaSmart, AmebaPro2, AmebaZ2 and friends.

ambsdk.title: Ameba RTOS SDK
ambsdk.description: Realtek official ameba-rtos SDK with built-in CMake/Ninja build system. Wraps `ameba.py build/flash/clean` so PlatformIO drives the upstream toolchain directly. The SDK checkout is located via $AMEBA_SDK_DIR or the default ~/projects/ameba-rtos. v0.1: not distributed as a PIO package.
